concepts.gloss_en: Mordekhai (the biblical figure from the Book of Esther)

reason_for_human: All 12 occurrences are the proper name Mordekhai from the Book of Esther. The two vocalizations shown (מָרְדֳּכַי and מָרְדְּכָי) are just pausal/positional variants of the same name, not homographs. The many different partners (freedom, hands, denial of idolatry, Malkhut, cypresses, the tzaddik, rav chesed) are all distinct symbolic 'aspects' Rebbe Nachman assigns to the same single figure — one concept, not several words.
